title: [ VX A] Tiles for animated sinking water level in a cave

posts.author: Tw0Face
posts.body: I want to build a flooded cave with RTP tiles and am looking for the corresponding water tiles. The highlight of the gameplay is that the player has to pull a kind of plug and the water then drains away gradually. So I'm looking for an RTP-compatible animated water tile that can also simulate the effect of the water draining. I've been searching for hours for a way to implement this, but can't find anything useful in the world wide web. I don't want to just fade out the screen and then the water changes from 100 to 0. I want the water level to drop gradually, so you can sort of watch the progress. Any idea on how I can do this? Anyone knows tiles to make this happen?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Well, You'd need water tiles that gradually show more "wall" on the top side.
Not sure if this tile already technically matches with the wall tiles, but I imagine you could go an make an edit of that. I would think you'll then need them to be events on top of the regular water tiles and when you pull the plug, you use a tileset change to get rid of the "real" water tiles, turn on your edited event water tiles, and have them "drain", before removing all of the water.
Something like that.

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
To elaborate on SGHarlekin's suggestion as it is, in practice, the easiest.
Tiles of the empty space you will have after the water has drained.
Character tile sheet of water, set to the opacity levels you want, with the tiles set so that the set route commands 'turn left', 'turn right', 'turn up' show lowering water level.  You will have to play around with the wait command between each move.
You will, of course, want several of these events as I assume the cave is more than one tile wide.  Copy/paste the event the number of times needed.  The tricky bit is getting all the events to lower the water at the same time and at the same speed.
Do the set route move command for the first event.  Let us assume that it is event #20.
Immediately underneath that command, do the following script call
Code:
[21, 22, 23, 24].each do |event_id|
  $game_map.events[event_id].force_move_route($game_map.events[20].move_route)
end
21, 22, 23, 24 are the ids of the events I want to mimic the first one, i.e. event #20.  You can have as many mimic events as you like.
